summary: Wheels Up Experience Inc. filed an 8-K regarding Amendment No. 5 to its 2023 Credit Agreement, executed July 31, 2026. The amendment extends the availability period of Delta Air Lines' $100 million revolving credit facility by two years, to September 20, 2028. No other terms—amounts, covenants, collateral, or events of default—were changed. Delta retains its 36.3% beneficial ownership of Class A common stock, with voting rights capped at 29.9%. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation; no strategic event, pricing, or structural change warrant classification.
